name: Rare UI
summary: Free shadcn registry of rare animated React pieces; MIT + Commons Clause + Attribution.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 22 registry:ui items — not a full inventory.
License is MIT + Commons Clause + Attribution (not plain MIT); attribution to rareui.com required; Commons Clause restricts selling/redistributing the components themselves.

rareui.com returns Vercel Security Checkpoint 403 even to Playwright Chrome from this network — demos use official gallery preview MP4s via jsDelivr (static-preview); docs URLs remain rareui.com/components/{path} in copyPrompt.

Registry JSON verified HTTP 200 via jsDelivr GitHub mirror (public/r/{slug}.json); rareui.com/r/{slug}.json also 403 to bots. Install still uses official `npx shadcn@latest add swamimalode07/rare-ui/{name}`.
family-drawer exists in registry.json but is commented out of the gallery list — excluded this packet.
No dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
